title: Field: filter.feedId
description: Meaning and invariants of the buyer query filter.feedId field.
meaning: Constrains the search to one feed-driven buyer surface.

invariants.label: Contextual
invariants.value: Only meaningful in feed-driven flows where a feed context exists.

invariants.label: Not category
invariants.value: A feed is a browsing surface, not the same as a category.

text:
# filter.feedId

TL;DR:
- filter.feedId narrows the query to one feed-driven buyer surface.

What it means:
- It is for feed-scoped browsing, not for generic category or fulltext filtering.

Agent hint:
- Use it when the workflow explicitly comes from a feed context. If no feed context exists, do not invent one.
